integrity: New scientific claims supported by a self-contained combinatorial proof. Exhaustive finite checks are separate corroboration, not a proof for unbounded run lengths. Source citations refer to accessible public literature; no claim of independent scientific validation.
scientific_limitations: Exact classification of all optimal two-position attractors; when the minimum is three, existence and optimality are proved but all three-position minimizers are not enumerated. Only positive four-run binary words are addressed. A broader, unlocated published classification could subsume the result.
title: Sharp size-two string-attractor phase diagram for four-run binary words
